H4210: properly, instrumental music; by implication, a poem set to notes
H3117: a day (as the warm hours), whether literal (from sunrise to sunset, or from one sunset to the next), or figurative (a space of time defined by an associated term), (often used adverb)
H2896: good (as an adjective) in the widest sense; used likewise as a noun, both in the masculine and the feminine, the singular and the plural (good, a good or good thing, a good man or woman; the good, goods or good things, good men or women), also as an adverb (well)
H3034: physically, to throw (a stone, an arrow) at or away; especially to revere or worship (with extended hands); intensively, to bemoan (by wringing the hands)
H3068: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
H2167: play upon it; to make music, accompanied by the voice; hence to celebrate in song and music
H8034: an appellation, as amark or memorial of individuality; by implication honor, authority, character
H5945: an elevation, i.e. (adj.) lofty (compar.); as title, the Supreme
H5046: properly, to front, i.e. stand boldly out opposite; by implication (causatively), to manifest; figuratively, to announce (always by word of mouth to one present); specifically, to expose, predict, explain, praise
H1242: properly, dawn (as the break of day); generally, morning
H2617: kindness; by implication (towards God) piety; rarely (by opposition) reproof, or (subject.) beauty
H530: literally firmness; figuratively security; morally fidelity
H3915: properly, a twist (away of the light), i.e. night; figuratively, adversity
H5921: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
H6218: ten; by abbreviated form ten strings, and so a decachord
H5035: a skin-bag for liquids (from collapsing when empty); hence, a vase (as similar in shape when full); also a lyre (as having a body of like form)
H1902: a murmuring sound, i.e. a musical notation (probably similar to the modern affettuoso to indicate solemnity of movement); by implication, a machination
H3588: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
H8055: probably to brighten up, i.e. (figuratively) be (causatively, make) blithe or gleesome
H4639: an action (good or bad); generally, a transaction; abstractly, activity; by implication, a product (specifically, a poem) or (generally) property
H3027: a hand (the open one (indicating power, means, direction, etc.),
H7442: properly, to creak (or emit a stridulous sound), i.e. to shout (usually for joy)
H4100: properly, interrogative what? (including how? why? when?); but also exclamation, what! (including how!), or indefinitely what (including whatever, and even relatively, that which); often used with prefixes in various adverbial or conjunctive senses
H1431: to be (causatively make) large (in various senses, as in body, mind, estate or honor, also in pride)
H3966: properly, vehemence, i.e. (with or without preposition) vehemently; by implication, wholly, speedily, etc. (often with other words as an intensive or superlative; especially when repeated)
H6009: to be (causatively, make) deep (literally or figuratively)
H4284: a contrivance, i.e. (concretely) a texture, machine, or (abstractly) intention, plan (whether bad, a plot; or good, advice)
H376: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term (and in such cases frequently not expressed in translation)
H1198: properly, foot (as consumed); i.e. (by exten.) of cattle brutishness; (concretely) stupid
H3808: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
H3045: to know (properly, to ascertain by seeing); used in a great variety of senses, figuratively, literally, euphemistically and inferentially (including observation, care, recognition; and causatively, instruction, designation, punishment, etc.)
H3684: properly, fat, i.e. (figuratively) stupid or silly
H995: to separate mentally (or distinguish), i.e.(generally) understand
H853: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
H6524: to break forth as a bud, i.e. bloom; generally, to spread; specifically, to fly (as extending the wings); figuratively, to flourish
H7563: morally wrong; concretely, an (actively) bad person
H3644: a form of the prefix 'k-', but used separately as, thus, so
H6692: to twinkle, i.e. glance; by analogy, to blossom (figuratively, flourish)
H3605: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
H6466: to do or make (systematically and habitually), especially to practise
H205: strictly nothingness; also trouble. vanity, wickedness; specifically an idol
H5703: properly, a (peremptory) terminus, i.e. (by implication) duration, in the sense of advance or perpetuity (substantially as a noun, either with or without a preposition)
H5704: as far (or long, or much) as, whether of space (even unto) or time (during, while, until) or degree (equally with)
H859: thou and thee, or (plural) ye and you
H4791: altitude, i.e. concretely (an elevated place), abstractly (elevation, figuratively (elation), or adverbially (aloft)
H5769: properly, concealed, i.e. the vanishing point; generally, time out of mind (past or future), i.e. (practically) eternity; frequentatively, adverbial (especially with prepositional prefix) always
H6: properly, to wander away, i.e. lose oneself; by implication to perish (causative, destroy)
H6504: to break through, i.e. spread or separate (oneself)
H7311: to be high actively, to rise or raise (in various applications, literally or figuratively)
H7161: a horn (as projecting); by implication, a flask, cornet; by resemblance. an elephant's tooth (i.e. ivory), a corner (of the altar), a peak (of a mountain), a ray (of light); figuratively, power
H1101: to overflow (specifically with oil.); by implication, to mix; to fodder
H8081: grease, especially liquid (as from the olive, often perfumed); figuratively, richness
H7488: verdant; by analogy, new; figuratively, prosperous
H5027: to scan, i.e. look intently at; by implication, to regard with pleasure, favor or care
H5869: an eye (literally or figuratively); by analogy, a fountain (as the eye of the landscape)
H6965: to rise (in various applications, literal, figurative, intensive and causative)
H7489: properly, to spoil (literally, by breaking to pieces); figuratively, to make (or be) good fornothing, i.e. bad (physically, socially or morally)
H8085: to hear intelligently (often with implication of attention, obedience, etc.; causatively, to tell, etc.)
H241: broadness. i.e. (concrete) the ear (from its form in man)
H730: a cedar tree (from the tenacity of its roots)
H3844: Lebanon, a mountain range in Palestine
H1004: a house (in the greatest variation of applications, especially family, etc.)
H2691: a yard (as inclosed by a fence); also a hamlet (as similarly surrounded with walls)
H430: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus, especially with the article) of the supreme God; occasionally applied by way of deference to magistrates; and sometimes as a superlative
H5750: properly, iteration or continuance; used only adverbially (with or without preposition), again, repeatedly, still, more
H5107: to germinate, i.e. (figuratively) to (causatively, make) flourish; also (of words), to utter
H1961: to exist, i.e. be or become, come to pass (always emphatic, and not a mere copula or auxiliary)
H6697: properly, a cliff (or sharp rock, as compressed); generally, a rock or boulder; figuratively, a refuge; also an edge (as precipitous)
